author.name: Mirella M. Moro, Ricardo Cerri, Luiz Mershmann, Alexandre Plastino, Wagner Meira, André Carvalho

description: Official LaTeX template for the KDMiLe (Symposium on Knowledge Discovery, Mining and Learning). Provides a one-column ACM-Transactions-inspired layout with running headers/footers, multi-author/multi-institution affiliation blocks, abstract/CCS-concepts/keywords environments, custom theorem-like environments, narrow-figure and landscape table support, an appendix command, and Chicago-style author-year citations, based on a custom kdmile document class.
